  bed file extractioin for the CRT target 
  ```{r}
  ################################################################################
  # CHUNK 1: CREATE CRT TARGET BED FILE
  # Purpose:
  #   Defines the eight CRT amplicon/target intervals used for read extraction.
  # Input:
  #   Coordinates are hard-coded from the mad4hatter poolinfo design.
  # Output:
  #   data/input/bed/crt_bed.bed
  # Thresholds:
  #   None. This chunk only writes the selected target coordinates.
  ################################################################################
  library(tidyr)
  library(dplyr)
  # this bed is prepared from the mad4hatter poolinfo
  crt_bed <- data.frame(
    chr = rep("Pf3D7_07_v3", 8),
    start = c(403499, 403507, 403833, 404357, 404808, 405357, 405549, 405597),
    end = c(403683, 403717, 404021, 404564, 404981, 405543, 405743, 405815),
    chr_pos = c("Pf3D7_07_v3-403499-403683", "Pf3D7_07_v3-403507-403717",
                "Pf3D7_07_v3-403833-404021", "Pf3D7_07_v3-404357-404564",
                "Pf3D7_07_v3-404808-404981", "Pf3D7_07_v3-405357-405543",
                "Pf3D7_07_v3-405549-405743", "Pf3D7_07_v3-405597-405815"),
    length = c(184, 210, 188, 207, 173, 186, 194, 218),
    strand = rep("+", 8)
  )

  write.table(
    crt_bed %>% select(chr, start, end, chr_pos, length, strand),
    "data/input/bed/crt_bed.bed",
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )
  ```

  ```{r}
  ################################################################################
  # CHUNK 3: BUILD CRT HAPLOTYPE GENOTYPE GROUPS
  # Purpose:
  #   Reads PathWeaver amino-acid calls, keeps Ethiopia 2024 samples, extracts CRT
  #   codons 74, 75, and 76, and assigns each sample to a binary genotype group.
  # Inputs:
  #   - supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv for sample metadata and FWS.
  #   - output/crt_seekdeep_output/.../AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz for amino-acid calls.
  # Outputs:
  #   - output/crt_genotype/crt_haplotype_genotype.tsv
  #   - output/samples/ethiopia_samples.txt
  # Thresholds/filters:
  #   - Year == 2024 and Country == Ethiopia.
  #   - AA_cnt != 0 removes positions with no supporting amino-acid reads.
  #   - filter(!grepl("0.", AA_freq)) removes mixed/heterozygous calls so only
  #     fixed calls are used for genotype grouping.
  #   - CVIET haplotype M74I/N75E/K76T is coded as 1/1; all others as 0/0.
  ################################################################################
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)

  suppleme_fws <- read.csv(
    "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv",
    sep = "\t"
  ) %>%
  #   select(sample_id, Country, fws) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sample_id)) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
    filter(Year == 2024) %>%
    select(Sample, Country, fws,Site) |> 
    filter(Country == "Ethiopia") 
readr::write_tsv(suppleme_fws,"metadata_sample/ethiopia_samples_2024.tsv",col_names = TRUE)

  # to see the px1 and the carl gene
  seekdeep_output_additional <- read.csv(  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output/crt_seekdeep_output/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/summary/AAChangesInfo.tsv.gz",
    sep = "\t") %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", sample)) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
    mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  #   mutate(Gene = recode(Gene, "PF3D7_1251200" = "Coronin")) %>%
    #filter(Gene %in% c("Coronin","PX1","AAT1","AP2-MU","UBP1","Kelch13","CRT","PPPK-DHPS","DHFR-TS","MDR1"))%>%
    filter(AA_cnt != 0) %>%
    select(
      Sample,
      Gene,
      Gene_ID,
      reference_AA_pos,
      reference_AA,
      AA,
      is_reference,
      AA_freq,
      AA_cnt
    ) %>%
    # dplyr::rename(Read = AA_cnt)
    right_join(suppleme_fws, by = "Sample")

  colnames(seekdeep_output_additional)
  wide_sample <- seekdeep_output_additional %>%
    filter(!grepl("0." , AA_freq)) |> # this filter out hetrozygous and missing samples
    mutate(
      mutation_status = ifelse(reference_AA == AA, "wildtype", "mutant"),
      mutation_test = ifelse(
        reference_AA == AA,
        paste0("0", "(", AA_freq, ")"),
        paste0(reference_AA, reference_AA_pos, AA, "(", AA_freq, ")")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Sample, Gene, reference_AA_pos, mutation_test, Country) %>%
    group_by(Gene, reference_AA_pos, Sample) %>%
    summarise(
      mutation_test = paste(unique(mutation_test), collapse = ";"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
      filter(reference_AA_pos %in% c(74, 75, 76)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = reference_AA_pos,
      values_from = mutation_test,
      values_fill = "NA"
    ) |> 
      mutate(haplotype = paste(`74`, `75`, `76`, sep = "/")) |> 
      # filter(haplotype != "0(1)/0(1)/0(1)") |> 
      left_join(suppleme_fws, by = "Sample")
      
    distinict_haplotype <- wide_sample %>%
      select(haplotype)|>
      distinct() 
    print(distinict_haplotype)

    haplotype_freq <- wide_sample %>%
      group_by(Site) |>
      mutate(n_samples = n_distinct(Sample)) |>
      group_by(Site, haplotype,n_samples) |>
      summarise(n_samples_haplotype = n_distinct(Sample), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(freq = n_samples_haplotype / n_samples)

  crt_haplotype_genotype <- wide_sample%>%
    select(Sample,haplotype)%>%
    mutate(genotype = ifelse(haplotype == "M74I(1)/N75E(1)/K76T(1)","1/1","0/0"))%>%
    select(-haplotype)

  readr::write_tsv(
    crt_haplotype_genotype,
    "output/crt_genotype/crt_haplotype_genotype.tsv"
  )

  # country_n <- seekdeep_output_additional %>%
  #   group_by(Country) %>%
  #   summarise(
  #     total_samples = n_distinct(Sample),
  #     .groups = "drop"
  #   )

  # # Variant frequencies
  # allelic_freq <- seekdeep_output_additional %>%
  #   mutate(
  #     aa_change = paste0(reference_AA, ">", AA)
  #   ) %>%
  #   group_by(
  #     Country,
  #     Gene,
  #     reference_AA_pos,
  #     aa_change,
  #     is_reference,
  #     AA_freq
  #   ) %>%
  #   summarise(
  #     n_samples = n_distinct(Sample),
  #     .groups = "drop"
  #   ) %>%
  #   left_join(country_n, by = "Country") %>%
  #   filter(is_reference == FALSE) %>%
  #   mutate(
  #     freq = n_samples / total_samples,
  #     freq_label = paste0(
  #       round(freq, 3),
  #       " (",
  #       n_samples,
  #       "/",
  #       total_samples,

  #   ) %>%
  #   select(

  #     values_from = freq_label,

  #   arrange(Gene, reference_AA_pos)

  # readr::write_tsv(

  #   "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/genotype_extraction/seekdeep_output/pathweaveroutput_aat1_ap2mu_mca_kic/wide_sample_seekdeep_output_all_additional_variant_allel_freq.tsv"
  ```

  ```{bash}
  #!/bin/bash
  ################################################################################
  # CHUNK 4: PREPARE ETHIOPIA CRT WHOLE-GENOME SNP MATRIX
  # Purpose:
  #   Builds the filtered whole-genome SNP input used by iHS/XP-EHH and hmmIBD.
  #   It keeps Ethiopian samples, applies a MAF filter, removes hypervariable
  #   regions plus high-diversity Tajima's D windows, converts the final VCF to a
  #   binary genotype matrix, and creates a gene annotation table for SNPs.
  # Inputs:
  #   - Whole-country VCF: INPUT_VCF.
  #   - Ethiopian sample list from CHUNK 3.
  #   - Hypervariable-region CSV: NEW_HYPER_VAR_CSV.
  # Outputs:
  #   - Ethiopia-only MAF-filtered VCF.
  #   - output/combined_exclusion_032026.bed.
  #   - Hypervariable/Tajima-filtered VCF and index.
  #   - fastq2matrix .mat.bin genotype matrix.
  #   - wide.gene.tsv SNP-to-gene annotation file.
  # Thresholds/filters:
  #   - bcftools -q 0.01 keeps variants with MAF >= 0.01.
  #   - vcftools --TajimaD 10000 calculates Tajima's D in 10 kb windows.
  #   - Top 10% highest Tajima's D windows are excluded as high-diversity windows.
  #   - Pf3D7_API_v3 and Pf_M76611 are removed later from downstream analyses.
  ################################################################################

  SCRIPT_DIR="~/software/malaria-hub/selection/"
  DATA_DIR="${DATA_DIR:-$PWD}"
  EHH_DIR="${EHH_DIR:-$(dirname "$DATA_DIR")}"

  cd "$DATA_DIR" || { echo "ERROR: Cannot cd to DATA_DIR=$DATA_DIR"; exit 1; }

  source /mnt/storage13/leen/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
  conda activate fastq2matrix

  INPUT_VCF="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz"
  NEW_HYPER_VAR_CSV="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/data/input/hypervariable_region/hypervarregions_032026.csv"
  # R622I_CSV="/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/input_files/R622I_longformat.csv"

  #Extract Ethiopian samples only
  bcftools view -S output/samples/ethiopia_samples.txt "$INPUT_VCF" -q 0.01 \
    -o data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz -O z

  #MAF 0.01
  bcftools view data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz \
    -q 0.01 -o data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz -O z

  # Calculate Tajima's D on pre-exclusion VCF (after MAF filtering), then build
  # combined exclusion BED from:
  #   (a) hypervarregions_032026.csv regions
  #   (b) top 10% of Tajima's D windows
  # Apply both exclusions together in a single bcftools step.
  vcftools --gzvcf data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz \
    --out output/tajimas/tajimasd --TajimaD 10000

  tail -n +2 output/tajimas/tajimasd.Tajima.D | sort -k4 -rn > output/tajimas/tajimasd_sorted.txt
  n_windows=$(wc -l < output/tajimas/tajimasd_sorted.txt)
  top10pct=$(( (n_windows + 9) / 10 ))
  echo "Tajima's D: $n_windows windows total, excluding top $top10pct (10%)"
  head -n "$top10pct" output/tajimas/tajimasd_sorted.txt \
    | awk '{print $1"\t"$2"\t"$2+10000}' > output/tajimas/top10pct_tajima_windows.bed

  tail -n +2 "$NEW_HYPER_VAR_CSV" | cut -f1-3 > output/hypervariable_region/hypervar_regions_032026.bed

  cat output/hypervariable_region/hypervar_regions_032026.bed output/tajimas/top10pct_tajima_windows.bed \
    | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > output/combined_exclusion_032026.bed
  echo "Combined exclusion BED: $(wc -l < output/combined_exclusion_032026.bed) regions"

  echo "SNPs before exclusion:"
  bcftools view -H data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz | wc -l

  bcftools view \
    --targets-file ^output/combined_exclusion_032026.bed \
    data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz \
    -o data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.vcf.gz \
    -O z

  bcftools index data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.vcf.gz

  echo "SNPs after exclusion (hypervar + top 10% Tajima's D):"
  bcftools view -H data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.vcf.gz | wc -l

  #Convert to binary matrix
  python ~/software/fastq2matrix/scripts/vcf2matrix.py \
      --vcf data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.vcf.gz \
      --no-iupacgt \
      --na NA \
      --threads 32

  #Create annotation TSV
  bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT\t%INFO/BCSQ\n' \
    data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.vcf.gz \
    > data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.wide.tsv

  awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {split($5,a,"|"); print $1,$2,$3,$4,a[2]}' \
    data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.wide.tsv \
    > data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.wide.gene.tsv

  sed -i '1s/^/chr\tpos\tref\talt\tGene_name\n/' \
    data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.wide.gene.tsv
  ```

  ```{python}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CHUNK 5: MERGE CRT GENOTYPE GROUPS WITH SAMPLE METADATA
# Purpose:
#   Joins the CRT haplotype genotype calls from CHUNK 3 to the main metadata so
#   downstream scripts can filter by sample ID, FWS, country, and cviet_group.
# Inputs:
#   - supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv
#   - output/crt_genotype/crt_haplotype_genotype.tsv
# Output:
#   - output/crt_genotype/metadata_cviet_group.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - Keeps only 0/0 and 1/1 calls; heterozygous or missing calls are excluded.
#   - 0/0 = cvmnnk_wt; 1/1 = cviet_mut.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import pandas as pd

meta = pd.read_csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv", sep="\t")
r622i = pd.read_csv("output/crt_genotype/crt_haplotype_genotype.tsv", sep="\t")
r622i = r622i[r622i["genotype"].isin(["0/0", "1/1"])]
r622i["cviet_group"] = r622i["genotype"].map({"0/0": "cvmnnk_wt", "1/1": "cviet_mut"})
r622i_uniq = r622i[["Sample", "cviet_group"]].drop_duplicates("Sample").rename(columns={"Sample": "wgs_id"})
merged = meta.merge(r622i_uniq, left_on="sample_id", right_on="wgs_id", how="inner")
merged.to_csv("output/crt_genotype/metadata_cviet_group.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
print(merged["cviet_group"].value_counts().to_string())

  ```

  ```{bash}
  ################################################################################
  # CHUNK 6: RUN iHS AND XP-EHH FOR CRT GENOTYPE GROUPS
  # Purpose:
  #   Prepares rehh input per CRT group and calculates iHS within each group plus
  #   XP-EHH between groups using the filtered genome-wide SNP matrix.
  # Inputs:
  #   - Filtered .mat.bin genotype matrix from CHUNK 4.
  #   - metadata_cviet_group.tsv from CHUNK 5.
  #   - SNP gene annotation table from CHUNK 4.
  # Outputs:
  #   - output/ihs_result/high_ihs_all_categories.tsv
  #   - output/ihs_result/high_xpehh_all_categories.tsv
  #   - annotated window files used later for integrated selection analysis.
  # Thresholds/filters:
  #   - --fws_th 0.95 keeps monoclonal/high-quality infections only.
  #   - --remove_chr removes Pf3D7_API_v3 and Pf_M76611.
  #   - --forced_mixed allows matrix preparation even when group composition is
  #     mixed after filtering.
  ################################################################################
  #Run selection
  conda activate selection

  PROJECT_DIR="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
  ANNOTATION="$PROJECT_DIR/data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.wide.gene.tsv"

  mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR/output/ihs_result"
  cd "$PROJECT_DIR/output/ihs_result"
  printf 'cvmnnk_wt\ncviet_mut\n' | xargs -I {} -P 2 sh -c "Rscript '$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/prepare_input_rehh_per_category.R' \
    -d . \
    -b $PROJECT_DIR/data/input/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.ethiopia.only.MAF0.01.hypervarrem.vqslod.filt.snps.tajrem.mat.bin \
    --remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611 \
    --metadata $PROJECT_DIR/output/crt_genotype/metadata_cviet_group.tsv \
    --annotation '$ANNOTATION' \
    -c {} \
    --label_category cviet_group \
    --label_fws fws \
    --fws_th 0.95 \
    --label_id wgs_id \
    --forced_mixed"

  Rscript "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/calculate_rehh_metrics.R" \
    -d . \
    --prefix scanned_haplotypes \
    --remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611 \
    --list_category <(printf 'cvmnnk_wt\ncviet_mut\n') \
    --annotation "$ANNOTATION" \
    --gene_product "$PROJECT_DIR/data/input/pf_genome_product.tsv"
  ```

Running the hmmIBD for the crt genotype groups (cvmnnk_wt vs cviet_mut) and summarising the results.
```{bash}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 7: RUN hmmIBD AND SUMMARISE IBD BY CRT GROUP
# Purpose:
#   Runs hmmIBD separately for cvmnnk_wt and cviet_mut, summarises IBD sharing in
#   10 kb genome windows, makes chromosome-painting BED/PDF outputs, and combines
#   the annotated IBD windows into one table for downstream integration.
# Inputs:
#   - Whole-genome binary matrix BINARY.
#   - metadata_cviet_group.tsv from CHUNK 5.
#   - pf_genome_product.tsv and Pf3D7 FASTA index for annotation.
# Outputs:
#   - output/hmmibd_result/crt/*_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb*.tsv
#   - output/hmmibd_result/crt/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - --fws_th 0.95 keeps samples with FWS >= 0.95.
#   - --maf 0.01 keeps SNPs with MAF >= 0.01 for hmmIBD.
#   - --window_size 10000 summarises IBD in 10 kb windows.
#   - --quantile_cutoff 0.95 labels the top 5% IBD windows per group.
#   - Pf3D7_API_v3 and Pf_M76611 are removed.
#   - The final comparison column is fixed to "crt"; genotype groups remain in
#     the existing category column.
################################################################################
DATA_DIR="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
cd "$DATA_DIR" || { echo "ERROR: Cannot cd to DATA_DIR=$DATA_DIR"; exit 1; }

BINARY="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.mat.bin"
METADATA="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv"
RSCRIPT=/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/scripts/run_hmmIBD_per_category.R
SUMMARY_RSCRIPT=/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/scripts/summary_hmmIBD_results.R
GENE_PRODUCT="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/data/input/pf_genome_product.tsv"
REF_INDEX="/mnt/storage13/ahri/plasmodium_falciparum/Pfalciparum.genome.fasta.fai"
# NORTH_DISTRICTS="Atseged Tsimbila|West Armachiho|K/Humera|Gondar|Shewa Robit Town"
# R622I_CSV="/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/input_files/R622I_longformat.csv"
# HRP_META="/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/input_files/sample_meta_with_hrp_status_updated.csv"
# PF_SIZES="/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/072025_pf_mgen_ethiopia_popgen/hmmIBD/Ethiopia/pf.sizes"

# Get column indices from metadata header
header=$(head -1 "$METADATA")
wgs_col=$(echo "$header"      | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^sample_id$"   | cut -d: -f1)
country_col=$(echo "$header"  | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^Country$"  | cut -d: -f1)
region_col=$(echo "$header"   | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^Region$"   | cut -d: -f1)
district_col=$(echo "$header" | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^District$" | cut -d: -f1)
year_col=$(echo "$header"     | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^Year$"     | cut -d: -f1)

echo "Columns — wgs_id: $wgs_col | Country: $country_col | Region: $region_col | District: $district_col | Year: $year_col"
echo ""

# Helper: run summary for a completed hmmIBD output directory
run_summary() {
    local outdir="$1"
    local list_file="$2"

    echo "  Summarising: $outdir"
    Rscript "$SUMMARY_RSCRIPT" \
        -d "$outdir" \
        --list_category "$list_file" \
        --legend "$outdir/ibd_matrix_hap_leg.tsv" \
        --gene_product "$GENE_PRODUCT" \
        --ref_index "$REF_INDEX" \
        --maf 0.01 \
        --window_size 10000 \
        --quantile_cutoff 0.95 \
        --remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611
}

# Centromere BED lines appended to every chromosome painting BED.
# chr10 is an estimate; all others from PMC5052046.
CENTROMERE_LINES="1\t457932\t460311\tcentromere
2\t447301\t450450\tcentromere
3\t597817\t600275\tcentromere
4\t642004\t644529\tcentromere
5\t455741\t457252\tcentromere
6\t478653\t480971\tcentromere
7\t809246\t811716\tcentromere
8\t299080\t301403\tcentromere
9\t1242138\t1244483\tcentromere
10\t1100000\t1102200\tcentromere
11\t831969\t834245\tcentromere
12\t1282774\t1285067\tcentromere
13\t1168128\t1170425\tcentromere
14\t1071524\t1075089\tcentromere"

# Helper: chromosome painting from a completed hmmIBD summary directory.
#   Produces one painting per category found in the *_q0.95.tsv (col 7).
paint_chromosomes() {
    local outdir="$1"
    local title_prefix="$2"

    local qtsv
    qtsv=$(ls "$outdir"/*_q0.95.tsv 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [[ -z "$qtsv" ]]; then
        echo "  WARNING: no *_q0.95.tsv found in $outdir — skipping chromosome painting."
        return
    fi

    # Get unique categories from col 7
    local grps
    grps=$(awk 'BEGIN{FS="\t"} NR>1 {print $7}' "$qtsv" | sort -u)

    for grp in $grps; do
        echo "  Chromosome painting: $title_prefix — $grp"
        local bedfile="$outdir/ibd_chrom_paint_${grp}.bed"

        # Filter to this category, convert to BED (0-based start)
        awk -v g="$grp" 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} NR>1 && $7==g {print $1, $2-1, $3, "high_IBD"}' \
            "$qtsv" > "$bedfile"

        # Append centromere positions
        printf "%b\n" "$CENTROMERE_LINES" >> "$bedfile"

        # Run jcvi (jcvi lives in the fastq2matrix conda env)
        ( cd "$outdir" && /mnt/storage13/leen/miniforge3/envs/fastq2matrix/bin/python \
            -m jcvi.graphics.chromosome "ibd_chrom_paint_${grp}.bed" \
            --size="$PF_SIZES" \
            --title="$title_prefix — $grp" \
            --gauge )
    done
}

# Helper: run hmmIBD for each line in a list file, writing outputs to outdir
run_hmmibd() {
    local list_file="$1"
    local label_category="$2"
    local metadata="$3"
    local outdir="$4"

    mkdir -p "$outdir"
    cat "$list_file" | xargs -I {} -P 2 sh -c "Rscript '$RSCRIPT' \
        -d '$outdir' \
        -b '$BINARY' \
        -m '$metadata' \
        -c {} \
        --label_category '$label_category' \
        --label_fws fws \
        --fws_th 0.95 \
        --label_id wgs_id \
        --maf 0.01 \
        --na_char NA \
        --remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611"
}

# Run hmmIBD for the crt genotype groups (cvmnnk_wt vs cviet_mut)
CVIET_LIST=$(mktemp)
printf 'cvmnnk_wt\ncviet_mut\n' > "$CVIET_LIST"
CVIET_METADATA="$DATA_DIR/output/crt_genotype/metadata_cviet_group.tsv"
CVIET_OUTDIR="$DATA_DIR/output/hmmibd_result/crt"

run_hmmibd "$CVIET_LIST" "cviet_group" "$CVIET_METADATA" "$CVIET_OUTDIR"
run_summary "$CVIET_OUTDIR" "$CVIET_LIST"
conda activate fastq2matrix
paint_chromosomes "$CVIET_OUTDIR" "CRT K76T"
rm -f "$CVIET_LIST"

# combining the annotated file
echo "=== Combining win10kb_annotated.tsv file ==="
combined="$CVIET_OUTDIR/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv"
comparison="crt"
annotated=$(ls -t "$CVIET_OUTDIR"/*_hmmIBD_ibd_win10kb_annotated.tsv 2>/dev/null | grep -v '_wide\.tsv$' | head -1)

if [[ -n "$annotated" ]]; then
  {
    head -1 "$annotated" | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, "comparison"}'
    tail -n +2 "$annotated" | awk -v cmp="$comparison" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, cmp}'
  } > "$combined"
  echo "  Combined file: $combined"
  wc -l "$combined"
else
  echo "  WARNING: no win10kb_annotated.tsv files found — nothing combined."
fi
echo ""

echo "All done."
```


TajimasD 
the reason for the number of samples is different from the number of samples in the metadata file is because we are filtering the samples based on the crt genotype (cvmnnk_wt vs cviet_mut) and also applying a FWS threshold of 0.95. Only samples that meet these criteria are included in the TajimasD analysis, which results in a subset of the total samples present in the metadata file.
```{bash}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 8: RUN TAJIMA'S D BY CRT GROUP AND MERGE OUTPUTS
# Purpose:
#   Creates sample lists for cvmnnk_wt and cviet_mut, runs Tajima's D separately
#   for each group, annotates significant windows, and merges raw and annotated
#   results into tables used by the window-level integration step.
# Inputs:
#   - Whole-genome VCF.
#   - Main metadata with FWS and country columns.
#   - output/crt_genotype/crt_haplotype_genotype.tsv from CHUNK 3.
# Outputs:
#   - output/tajimasD_by_crt/*_samples.txt
#   - output/tajimasD_by_crt/tajimasd_*_10kb.Tajima.D
#   - output/tajimasD_all_annotated_q0.1_merged.tsv
#   - output/tajimasD_by_crt/tajimasD_all_merged.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - FWS_TH=0.95 keeps samples with FWS >= 0.95.
#   - Country == Ethiopia keeps Ethiopian samples only.
#   - Genotype groups are cvmnnk_wt (0/0) and cviet_mut (1/1).
#   - vcftools --maf 0.01 keeps SNPs with MAF >= 0.01.
#   - vcftools --TajimaD 10000 calculates Tajima's D in 10 kb windows.
#   - annotate.R produces q0.1 annotated windows, used as the significant
#     annotated Tajima's D set for integration.
################################################################################
set -euo pipefail
conda activate fastq2matrix
DATA_DIR="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
cd "$DATA_DIR" || { echo "ERROR: Cannot cd to DATA_DIR=$DATA_DIR"; exit 1; }

VCF="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz"
METADATA="/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/supplementary_Data/supp_fws_up.tsv"
CRT_GENOTYPE_TSV="$DATA_DIR/output/crt_genotype/crt_haplotype_genotype.tsv"
# HRP_META="/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/input_files/sample_meta_with_hrp_status_updated.csv"
FWS_TH=0.95

# North Ethiopian districts (same definition as EHH analysis)
# NORTH_DISTRICTS="Atseged Tsimbila|West Armachiho|K/Humera|Gondar|Shewa Robit Town"

# Get column indices from header
header=$(head -1 "$METADATA")
wgs_col=$(echo "$header"     | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^sample_id$"  | cut -d: -f1)
country_col=$(echo "$header" | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^Country$" | cut -d: -f1)
region_col=$(echo "$header"  | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^Region$"  | cut -d: -f1)
district_col=$(echo "$header"| tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^District$"| cut -d: -f1)
year_col=$(echo "$header"    | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^Year$"     | cut -d: -f1)
fws_col=$(echo "$header"     | tr '\t' '\n' | grep -n "^fws$"      | cut -d: -f1)

echo "Column indices — wgs_id: $wgs_col | Country: $country_col | Region: $region_col | District: $district_col | Year: $year_col | fws: $fws_col"
echo ""

# Helper: run vcftools TajimaD for a sample list
run_tajima() {
    local label="$1"
    local sample_file="$2"
    local outdir="$3"
    local n_samples
    n_samples=$(wc -l < "$sample_file")
    echo "  Samples: $n_samples"
    if [ "$n_samples" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "  No samples found, skipping."
        return
    fi
    vcftools --gzvcf "$VCF" \
        --keep "$sample_file" \
        --maf 0.01 \
        --out "${outdir}/tajimasd_${label}_10kb" \
        --TajimaD 10000
    echo "  Done: ${outdir}/tajimasd_${label}_10kb.Tajima.D"
    echo ""
}

OUTDIR="output/tajimasD_by_crt"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
echo "=== CRT K76T: WT vs Mutant ==="
awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && ($2=="0/0" || $2=="1/1") {print $1 "\t" ($2=="0/0" ? "cvmnnk_wt" : "cviet_mut")}' \
    "$CRT_GENOTYPE_TSV" > "$OUTDIR/crt_lookup.tmp"
for group in cvmnnk_wt cviet_mut; do
    echo "Processing: $group"
    awk -F'\t' -v col_s="$wgs_col" -v col_c="$country_col" -v col_f="$fws_col" -v th="$FWS_TH" -v g="$group" \
        'BEGIN{while((getline line < ARGV[1])>0){split(line,a,"\t"); grp[a[1]]=a[2]} ARGV[1]=""}
         NR>1 && $col_c=="Ethiopia" && ($col_s in grp) && grp[$col_s]==g && $col_f >= th {print $col_s}' \
        "$OUTDIR/crt_lookup.tmp" "$METADATA" > "${OUTDIR}/${group}_samples.txt"
    run_tajima "$group" "${OUTDIR}/${group}_samples.txt" "$OUTDIR"
done
rm "$OUTDIR/crt_lookup.tmp"
echo "CRT K76T complete."
echo ""

# 3b. Annotate the CRT Tajima's D windows with gene/product info
conda activate selection
Rscript "$DATA_DIR/scripts/annotate.R" \
  --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
  --input_dir output/tajimasD_by_crt \
  --output_dir output/tajimasD_annotated_by_crt \
  --q 0.1 \
  --gene_product data/input/pf_genome_product.tsv \
  --rm_chr Pf_M76611,Pf3D7_API_v3
echo ""

# 3c. Merge annotated q0.1 files and add a comparison label.
# These files are already filtered/annotated by annotate.R at q0.1. The q0.1
# threshold means only the most extreme 10% of windows from the Tajima's D
# annotation step are retained for this table. The category/group column in each
# file identifies cvmnnk_wt or cviet_mut; the new comparison column records that
# these rows belong to the CRT analysis.
ANNOTATED_MERGED="$DATA_DIR/output/tajimasD_all_annotated_q0.1_merged.tsv"
header_written=0
> "$ANNOTATED_MERGED"
for f in "$DATA_DIR/output/tajimasD_annotated_by_crt"/*_annotated_q0.1.tsv; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    comparison="crt"
    if [[ $header_written -eq 0 ]]; then
        head -1 "$f" | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, "comparison"}' >> "$ANNOTATED_MERGED"
        header_written=1
    fi
    tail -n +2 "$f" | awk -v cmp="$comparison" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, cmp}' >> "$ANNOTATED_MERGED"
done
if [[ $header_written -eq 1 ]]; then
    echo "  Annotated merged: $ANNOTATED_MERGED ($(wc -l < "$ANNOTATED_MERGED") lines)"
else
    echo "  WARNING: no annotated q0.1 files found."
fi

# 3d. Merge raw Tajima.D files and add group/comparison labels.
# The raw vcftools files do not contain the CRT group name inside the table, so
# the group is parsed from filenames such as tajimasd_cvmnnk_wt_10kb.Tajima.D.
# These raw files include all 10 kb Tajima's D windows after the per-group sample,
# MAF >= 0.01, and FWS >= 0.95 filters above.
RAW_MERGED="$OUTDIR/tajimasD_all_merged.tsv"
header_written=0
> "$RAW_MERGED"
for dir in tajimasD_by_crt; do
    [[ -d "$OUTDIR" ]] || continue
    comparison="crt"
    for f in "$OUTDIR"/*.Tajima.D; do
        [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
        group=$(basename "$f" | sed 's/^tajimasd_//;s/_10kb\.Tajima\.D$//')
        if [[ $header_written -eq 0 ]]; then
            head -1 "$f" | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, "group", "comparison"}' >> "$RAW_MERGED"
            header_written=1
        fi
        tail -n +2 "$f" | awk -v g="$group" -v cmp="$comparison" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $0, g, cmp}' >> "$RAW_MERGED"
    done
done
if [[ $header_written -eq 1 ]]; then
    echo "  Raw merged: $RAW_MERGED ($(wc -l < "$RAW_MERGED") lines)"
else
    echo "  WARNING: no .Tajima.D files found."
fi
echo ""

echo "All done."
```

comp_selection_signals_snps
```{r}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 9: INTEGRATE SNP-LEVEL iHS AND XP-EHH SIGNALS
# Purpose:
#   Combines significant SNPs from iHS and XP-EHH into one SNP-level table. SNPs
#   are matched by chromosome and position, and XP-EHH rows are retained with iHS
#   rows only when the iHS group matches the first XP-EHH population.
# Inputs:
#   - output/ihs_result/high_ihs_all_categories.tsv
#   - output/ihs_result/high_xpehh_all_categories.tsv
# Output:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - The input files are already high-signal SNP sets generated upstream.
#   - n_datasets counts support from iHS and/or XP-EHH; 2 means both tools support
#     the same SNP for the same focal CRT group.
#   - PX1 is relabelled when PF3D7_0720700 appears in significant SNP annotations.
################################################################################
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
OUT_FILE <- "output/comp_selection_signals_snp/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv"
cat("Loading iHS data...\n")
ihs <- read.delim("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output/ihs_result/high_ihs_all_categories.tsv")
cat("  iHS SNPs:", nrow(ihs), "\n\n")


cat("Loading XP-EHH data...\n")
xpehh <- read.delim("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output/ihs_result/high_xpehh_all_categories.tsv")
cat("  XP-EHH SNPs:", nrow(xpehh), "\n\n")

IHS <- ihs %>% dplyr::select(CHR, POSITION, IHS, LOGPVALUE, Gene_name, category_name)
colnames(IHS) <- c("Chr", "Position", "IHS", "iHS_logp", "iHS_Gene", "iHS_Region")
setDT(IHS)
IHS <- unique(IHS)
cat("  iHS unique SNPs after dedup:", nrow(IHS), "\n")

XP <- xpehh %>% dplyr::select(CHR, POSITION, XPEHH, LOGPVALUE, Gene_name, category_name)
colnames(XP) <- c("Chr", "Position", "XPEHH", "XPEHH_logp", "XPEHH_Gene", "XPEHH_Comparison")
setDT(XP)
XP[, c("XPEHH_pop1", "XPEHH_pop2") := tstrsplit(XPEHH_Comparison, "|", fixed = TRUE)]
XP[, XPEHH_pop1 := trimws(XPEHH_pop1)]
XP[, XPEHH_pop2 := trimws(XPEHH_pop2)]
XP <- unique(XP)
cat("  XP-EHH unique SNPs after dedup:", nrow(XP), "\n")

cat("  Done.\n\n")



# PART 4: MERGE PER CHROMOSOME
# ==============================================================================

cat("Merging datasets...\n\n")

all_chrs <- sort(unique(c(IHS$Chr, XP$Chr)))
all_chrs <- all_chrs[!is.na(all_chrs)]

results_list <- list()

for (chr in all_chrs) {
  cat("  Chr", chr, "...\n")

  ihs_chr <- IHS[Chr == chr]
  xp_chr  <- XP[Chr == chr]

  ihs_chr[, .ihs_id := .I]
  xp_chr[,  .xp_id  := .I]

  cat("    iHS:", nrow(ihs_chr), "| XP-EHH:", nrow(xp_chr), "\n")

  result <- data.table()

  if (nrow(ihs_chr) > 0 && nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    ov_xp <- merge(ihs_chr, xp_chr, by = c("Chr", "Position"),
                   all = FALSE, allow.cartesian = TRUE)

    ov_xp <- ov_xp[
      !is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region == XPEHH_pop1
    ]

    ihs_matched <- unique(ov_xp$.ihs_id)
    xp_matched  <- unique(ov_xp$.xp_id)

    ihs_only <- ihs_chr[!.ihs_id %in% ihs_matched]
    xp_only  <- xp_chr[!.xp_id  %in% xp_matched]

    result <- rbind(ov_xp, ihs_only, fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(xp_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, xp_only, fill = TRUE)

  } else if (nrow(ihs_chr) > 0) {
    result <- ihs_chr
  } else if (nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    result <- xp_chr
  }

  cat("    After iHS+XP-EHH:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  temp_cols <- grep("^\\.", names(result), value = TRUE)
  if (length(temp_cols) > 0) result[, (temp_cols) := NULL]

  results_list[[as.character(chr)]] <- result

  rm(ihs_chr, xp_chr, result)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}


# PART 5: COMBINE AND FINALIZE
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCombining all chromosomes...\n")
result <- rbindlist(results_list, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
setorder(result, Chr, Position, na.last = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# PART 6: SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("INTEGRATION COMPLETE\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Final dataset: 'result'\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(result), "\n")
cat("  Chromosomes:", paste(sort(unique(result$Chr)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

result[, n_datasets := (!is.na(iHS_Region)) + (!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison))]

cat("Dataset overlap distribution:\n")
print(table(result$n_datasets))
cat("\n")

result[, combo := paste(
  ifelse(!is.na(iHS_Region),       "iHS", ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison), "XP",  ""),
  sep = "+"
)]
result[, combo := gsub("\\+{2,}", "+", combo)]
result[, combo := gsub("^\\+|\\+$", "", combo)]

cat("Dataset combinations (top 10):\n")
print(head(sort(table(result$combo), decreasing = TRUE), 10))

cat("\nFirst 20 rows:\n")
print(head(result, 20))

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Result stored in 'result' data.table\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")

# ==============================================================================
# ANNOTATION CHECK
# ==============================================================================

gene_cols <- grep("_Gene$", names(result), value = TRUE)
gene_strings <- unlist(result[, ..gene_cols])
gene_strings <- gene_strings[!is.na(gene_strings) & gene_strings != ""]

px1_hits <- grep("PF3D7_0720700", gene_strings, value = TRUE)
if (length(px1_hits) > 0) {
  for (col in gene_cols) {
    result[get(col) == "PF3D7_0720700", (col) := "PX1"]
  }
  cat("CHECK PASSED: PF3D7_0720700 found and relabelled as PX1 in", length(px1_hits), "row(s)\n")
} else {
  cat("CHECK NOTE: PF3D7_0720700 not present in this result (gene may not be in a significant SNP)\n")
}

# setwd(BASE_DIR)
fwrite(result, OUT_FILE, sep = "\t")
cat("Saved:", OUT_FILE, "\n")
```

for plotting the generated result for snp based on the iHS and XP-EHH results
```{r}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 10: PLOT SNP-LEVEL CRT SELECTION SIGNALS
# Purpose:
#   Makes per-group SNP visualisations from the integrated iHS/XP-EHH table:
#   1. Two-panel Manhattan plot with iHS on top and XP-EHH below.
#   2. Scatter plot comparing iHS -log10(p) and XP-EHH -log10(p) for SNPs found
#      by both tools.
# Inputs:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv
# Outputs:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/snp_plots_crt_*_manhattan.pdf
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_snp/snp_plots_crt_*_scatter.pdf
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - IHS_THRESH = -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.0))), equivalent to |iHS| >= 2.0.
#   - XPEHH_THRESH = -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.5))), equivalent to |XP-EHH| >= 2.5.
#   - TOP_N_GENES = 20 limits the maximum labelled genes per plot.
#   - Manhattan foreground points are restricted to SNPs detected by both tools.
################################################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IN_FILE        <- "output/comp_selection_signals_snp/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_SNPs.tsv"
OUT_PREFIX     <- "output/comp_selection_signals_snp/snp_plots_crt"
ANALYSIS_LABEL <- "CRT CVMNK (Ethiopia)"
IHS_THRESH     <- -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.0)))   # |iHS| >= 2.0 on logp scale
XPEHH_THRESH   <- -log10(2 * pnorm(-abs(2.5)))   # |XP-EHH| >= 2.5 on logp scale
TOP_N_GENES    <- 20

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "cvmnnk_wt" = "#D62728",
  "cviet_mut"  = "#4E79A7"
)

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "cvmnnk_wt" = "CRT CVMNK wild-type",
  "cviet_mut"  = "CRT CVIET mutant"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading:", IN_FILE, "\n")
snps <- read.delim(IN_FILE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Chr        = as.integer(Chr),
    Position   = as.numeric(Position),
    iHS_logp   = as.numeric(iHS_logp),
    XPEHH_logp = as.numeric(XPEHH_logp),
    n_datasets = as.integer(n_datasets)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chr), !is.na(Position))

cat("  Total SNP rows:", nrow(snps), "\n")
cat("  Detected by both tools:", sum(snps$n_datasets == 2, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. CHROMOSOME OFFSETS
# ==============================================================================

chr_lengths <- data.frame(
  Chr    = 1:14,
  length = c(643292, 947102, 1067971, 1200490, 1343557, 1418242, 1445207,
             1472805, 1541735, 1687656, 2038340, 2271494, 2925236, 3291936)
)

chr_offsets <- chr_lengths %>%
  arrange(Chr) %>%
  mutate(offset = cumsum(lag(length, default = 0)) + (Chr - 1) * 2e5)

chr_midpoints <- chr_offsets %>% mutate(mid = offset + length / 2)

snps <- snps %>%
  left_join(chr_offsets %>% select(Chr, offset), by = "Chr") %>%
  mutate(
    pos_cum = Position + offset,
    detection = case_when(
      n_datasets == 2                         ~ "Both tools",
      !is.na(iHS_logp)  & is.na(XPEHH_logp)  ~ "iHS only",
      is.na(iHS_logp)   & !is.na(XPEHH_logp) ~ "XP-EHH only",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Both tools"
    )
  )

det_colors <- c("Both tools" = "#D62728", "iHS only" = "#AEC7E8", "XP-EHH only" = "#FFBB78")
det_sizes  <- c("Both tools" = 1.2,       "iHS only" = 0.6,       "XP-EHH only" = 0.6)
det_alpha  <- c("Both tools" = 1.0,       "iHS only" = 0.5,       "XP-EHH only" = 0.5)

x_breaks <- chr_midpoints$mid
x_labs   <- as.character(chr_midpoints$Chr)
x_lim    <- range(snps$pos_cum, na.rm = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 3 & 4. PLOTS PER GROUP
# ==============================================================================

GROUP_COL <- "iHS_Region"

groups_in_data <- intersect(names(GROUP_COLORS), unique(snps[[GROUP_COL]]))
cat("Groups found in data:", paste(groups_in_data, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

for (grp in groups_in_data) {

  grp_label    <- ifelse(grp %in% names(GROUP_LABELS), GROUP_LABELS[[grp]], grp)
  cat("==============================\n")
  cat("Processing:", grp_label, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n")

  snps_c       <- filter(snps, .data[[GROUP_COL]] == grp)
  out_prefix_c <- paste0(OUT_PREFIX, "_", grp)

  if (nrow(snps_c) == 0) {
    cat("  No SNPs for", grp_label, "— skipping.\n\n")
    next
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 1 — TWO-PANEL MANHATTAN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cat("  Generating Manhattan plot...\n")

  ihs_pts <- snps_c %>%
    filter(!is.na(iHS_logp)) %>%
    group_by(Chr, Position, pos_cum, iHS_Region, iHS_Gene, detection) %>%
    summarise(iHS_logp = max(iHS_logp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  xp_pts <- snps_c %>%
    filter(!is.na(XPEHH_logp)) %>%
    group_by(Chr, Position, pos_cum, XPEHH_Comparison, XPEHH_Gene, detection) %>%
    summarise(XPEHH_logp = max(XPEHH_logp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ihs_fg <- ihs_pts %>% filter(iHS_logp   >= IHS_THRESH,   detection == "Both tools")
  xp_fg  <- xp_pts  %>% filter(XPEHH_logp >= XPEHH_THRESH, detection == "Both tools")

  ihs_labels <- ihs_fg %>%
    filter(!is.na(iHS_Gene) & iHS_Gene != "" & iHS_Gene != "NA") %>%
    group_by(iHS_Gene) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    slice_max(iHS_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    slice_max(iHS_logp, n = TOP_N_GENES, with_ties = FALSE)

  xp_labels <- xp_fg %>%
    filter(!is.na(XPEHH_Gene) & XPEHH_Gene != "" & XPEHH_Gene != "NA") %>%
    group_by(XPEHH_Gene) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    slice_max(XPEHH_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    slice_max(XPEHH_logp, n = TOP_N_GENES, with_ties = FALSE)

  p_ihs <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = pos_cum, y = iHS_logp)) +
    geom_point(data = ihs_fg, colour = "#D62728", size = 2.0, stroke = 0) +
    geom_text_repel(data = ihs_labels, aes(label = iHS_Gene), size = 2.5, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = IHS_THRESH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs, limits = x_lim,
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](p)~"(iHS)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

  p_xp <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = pos_cum, y = XPEHH_logp)) +
    geom_point(data = xp_fg, colour = "#D62728", size = 2.0, stroke = 0) +
    geom_text_repel(data = xp_labels, aes(label = XPEHH_Gene), size = 2.5, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey50",
                    segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42,
                    direction = "y") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = XPEHH_THRESH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labs, limits = x_lim,
                       expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    labs(x = "Chromosome", y = expression(-log[10](p)~"(XP-EHH)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

  p_manhattan <- plot_grid(p_ihs, p_xp, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1), align = "v")
  ggsave(paste0(out_prefix_c, "_manhattan.pdf"), plot = p_manhattan, width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", out_prefix_c, "_manhattan.pdf")

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PLOT 2 — iHS vs XP-EHH SCATTER (co-detected SNPs)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  cat("  Generating scatter plot...\n")

  scatter_df <- snps_c %>%
    filter(n_datasets == 2, !is.na(iHS_logp), !is.na(XPEHH_logp)) %>%
    group_by(Chr, Position, iHS_Region) %>%
    slice_max(XPEHH_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(gene_label = case_when(
      !is.na(iHS_Gene)   & iHS_Gene   != "" & iHS_Gene   != "NA" ~ iHS_Gene,
      !is.na(XPEHH_Gene) & XPEHH_Gene != "" & XPEHH_Gene != "NA" ~ XPEHH_Gene,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))

  cat("  Co-detected SNPs:", nrow(scatter_df), "\n")

  if (nrow(scatter_df) == 0) {
    cat("  No co-detected SNPs — skipping scatter.\n\n")
    next
  }

  sig_labels <- scatter_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_label),
           iHS_logp >= IHS_THRESH, XPEHH_logp >= XPEHH_THRESH) %>%
    group_by(gene_label) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    slice_max(iHS_logp + XPEHH_logp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  p_scatter <- ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = iHS_logp, y = XPEHH_logp)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, colour = GROUP_COLORS[grp]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = IHS_THRESH,   linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = XPEHH_THRESH, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sig_labels, aes(label = gene_label), size = 2.5, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey60",
                    segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
    labs(x = expression(-log[10](p)~"(iHS)"), y = expression(-log[10](p)~"(XP-EHH)"),
         title    = paste0("Co-detected SNPs — ", grp_label),
         subtitle = paste0(nrow(scatter_df), " SNPs detected by both iHS and XP-EHH")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3))

  ggsave(paste0(out_prefix_c, "_scatter.pdf"), plot = p_scatter, width = 8, height = 7, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", out_prefix_c, "_scatter.pdf")

  cat("\n")
}

cat("Done.\n")

```



window based selection analysis
```{r}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 11: INTEGRATE WINDOW-LEVEL SELECTION SIGNALS
# Purpose:
#   Combines window-level evidence from Tajima's D, iHS, XP-EHH, and hmmIBD for
#   the CRT groups. Windows are merged by physical overlap within chromosome and
#   retained as matching evidence only when they refer to the same CRT group.
# Inputs:
#   - output/tajimasD_all_annotated_q0.1_merged.tsv
#   - output/ihs_result/cr_ihs_all_categories_annot.tsv
#   - output/ihs_result/cr_xpehh_all_categories_annot.tsv
#   - output/hmmibd_result/crt/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv
# Output:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_window/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_windows.tsv
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - Tajima's D keeps extreme negative windows: bottom 15% per CRT group.
#   - IBD keeps high-sharing windows: top 15% per CRT group, using fraction >=
#     the 85th percentile.
#   - q0.1 Tajima annotated input is used from annotate.R as a prefiltered set.
#   - n_datasets counts support from TD, iHS, IBD, and XP-EHH.
# Important PX1 annotation note:
#   - PF3D7_0720700(PX1) may not appear in the original hmmIBD annotated file.
#   - If a final merged window overlaps the known PX1 coordinates
#     chr7:889883-899213, this script manually adds PF3D7_0720700(PX1) to the
#     gene/product columns.
#   - Therefore, a final row with combo == "IBD" and IBD_genes containing PX1
#     means the high-IBD window overlaps the PX1 locus by coordinates; it does
#     not necessarily mean PX1 was present in the original hmmIBD annotation.
################################################################################

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

# TD/IBD group names → EHH group names
GROUP_RECODE <- c("mut" = "cviet_mut", "wt" = "cvmnnk_wt")
GROUPS_EHH   <- c("cviet_mut", "cvmnnk_wt")   # names used in EHH files
GROUPS_TD_IBD <- names(GROUP_RECODE)           # names used in TD/IBD files

EHH_DIR  <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output/ihs_result"
OUT_FILE <- "output/comp_selection_signals_window/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_windows.tsv"

# ==============================================================================
# PART 1: LOAD AND PREPARE TAJIMA'S D DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading Tajima's D data...\n")

tajima_d <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background/output/tajimasD_all_annotated_q0.1_merged.tsv", sep = "\t")
tajima_d <- tajima_d %>% filter(!chr %in% c("Pf_M76611", "Pf3D7_API_v3"))

# tajima_d$group is already in the EHH naming convention (cvmnnk_wt/cviet_mut); no recode needed
tajima_d <- tajima_d %>% filter(group %in% GROUPS_EHH)

percentiles <- tajima_d %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(p_low  = quantile(TajimaD, 0.15, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_high = quantile(TajimaD, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

tajima_d2        <- tajima_d %>% left_join(percentiles, by = "group")
extremes_df_groups <- tajima_d2 %>% filter(!is.na(TajimaD) & TajimaD <= p_low)

cat("  Extreme negative Tajima's D windows:", nrow(extremes_df_groups), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 2: LOAD SELECTION DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading EHH data...\n")
cr_ihs   <- read.delim(file.path(EHH_DIR, "cr_ihs_all_categories_annot.tsv"))
cr_xpehh <- read.delim(file.path(EHH_DIR, "cr_xpehh_all_categories_annot.tsv"))
cat("  iHS windows:    ", nrow(cr_ihs), "\n")
cat("  XP-EHH windows:", nrow(cr_xpehh), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 3: LOAD IBD DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading IBD data...\n")
ibd <- read.delim("output/hmmibd_result/crt/hmmibd_combined_win10kb_annotated.tsv")
ibd <- ibd[ibd$category %in% GROUPS_EHH, ]

# Recode IBD categories to EHH naming convention
ibd$category <- dplyr::recode(ibd$category, !!!GROUP_RECODE)

percentiles_ibd <- ibd %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(p_low  = quantile(fraction, 0.15, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_high = quantile(fraction, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

ibd <- ibd %>%
  left_join(percentiles_ibd, by = "category") %>%
  filter(!is.na(fraction), fraction >= p_high)

cat("  High IBD windows:", nrow(ibd), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 4: STANDARDIZE FORMATS
# ==============================================================================

cat("Standardizing formats...\n")

TD <- extremes_df_groups %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, N_SNPS, TajimaD, genes, products, group)
colnames(TD) <- c("Chr", "TD_start", "TD_end", "TD_SNP_n", "TD",
                  "TD_genes", "TD_products", "TD_Region")
TD$Chr <- gsub("Pf3D7_0|Pf3D7_|_v3", "", TD$Chr)
TD$Chr <- as.numeric(as.character(TD$Chr))

cr_ihs <- cr_ihs %>% dplyr::select(chr, start, end, category_name, genes, products)
colnames(cr_ihs) <- c("Chr", "iHS_start", "iHS_end", "iHS_Region", "iHS_genes", "iHS_products")

ibd <- ibd %>% dplyr::select(chr, start, end, fraction, category, gene_name, gene_product)
colnames(ibd) <- c("Chr", "IBD_start", "IBD_end", "IBD_fraction", "IBD_Region",
                   "IBD_genes", "IBD_products")

cr_xpehh <- cr_xpehh %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, category_name, PERC_EXTR_MRK, genes, products)
colnames(cr_xpehh) <- c("Chr", "XPEHH_start", "XPEHH_end", "XPEHH_Comparison",
                        "XPEHH_extra_marks_p", "XPEHH_genes", "XPEHH_products")

setDT(TD); setDT(cr_ihs); setDT(ibd); setDT(cr_xpehh)
TD <- unique(TD); cr_ihs <- unique(cr_ihs)
ibd <- unique(ibd); cr_xpehh <- unique(cr_xpehh)

cat("  Done.\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 5: SPLIT XP-EHH INTO TWO POPULATIONS
# ==============================================================================

cat("Splitting XP-EHH comparisons into population pairs...\n")
cr_xpehh[, c("XPEHH_pop1", "XPEHH_pop2") := tstrsplit(XPEHH_Comparison, "|", fixed = TRUE)]
cr_xpehh[, XPEHH_pop1 := trimws(XPEHH_pop1)]
cr_xpehh[, XPEHH_pop2 := trimws(XPEHH_pop2)]
cat("  Split", nrow(cr_xpehh), "XP-EHH regions into pop1 and pop2\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 6: MERGE STEP-BY-STEP PER CHROMOSOME
# ==============================================================================

cat("Merging datasets...\n\n")

all_chrs <- sort(unique(c(TD$Chr, cr_ihs$Chr, ibd$Chr, cr_xpehh$Chr)))
all_chrs <- all_chrs[!is.na(all_chrs)]

results_list <- list()

for (chr in all_chrs) {
  cat("  Chr", chr, "...\n")

  TD_chr  <- TD[Chr == chr]
  ihs_chr <- cr_ihs[Chr == chr]
  ibd_chr <- ibd[Chr == chr]
  xp_chr  <- cr_xpehh[Chr == chr]

  TD_chr[,  .td_id  := .I]
  ihs_chr[, .ihs_id := .I]
  ibd_chr[, .ibd_id := .I]
  xp_chr[,  .xp_id  := .I]

  cat("    TD:", nrow(TD_chr), "| iHS:", nrow(ihs_chr),
      "| IBD:", nrow(ibd_chr), "| XP-EHH:", nrow(xp_chr), "\n")

  # === STEP 1: TD + iHS ===
  result      <- data.table()
  td_matched  <- integer(0)
  ihs_matched <- integer(0)

  if (nrow(TD_chr) > 0 && nrow(ihs_chr) > 0) {
    setkeyv(TD_chr,  c("Chr", "TD_start",  "TD_end"))
    setkeyv(ihs_chr, c("Chr", "iHS_start", "iHS_end"))

    ov <- foverlaps(TD_chr, ihs_chr, type = "any", nomatch = NULL)
    ov <- ov[TD_start < iHS_end & iHS_start < TD_end]
    ov <- ov[TD_Region == iHS_Region]

    if (nrow(ov) > 0) {
      result      <- rbind(result, ov, fill = TRUE)
      td_matched  <- ov$.td_id
      ihs_matched <- ov$.ihs_id
    }
  }

  if (nrow(TD_chr)  > 0) {
    td_only <- TD_chr[!.td_id %in% td_matched]
    if (nrow(td_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, td_only, fill = TRUE)
  }
  if (nrow(ihs_chr) > 0) {
    ihs_only <- ihs_chr[!.ihs_id %in% ihs_matched]
    if (nrow(ihs_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, ihs_only, fill = TRUE)
  }

  cat("    After TD+iHS:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  # === STEP 2: + IBD ===
  if (nrow(result) > 0 && nrow(ibd_chr) > 0) {
    start_cols2 <- intersect(c("TD_start", "iHS_start"), names(result))
    end_cols2   <- intersect(c("TD_end",   "iHS_end"),   names(result))
    result[, unified_start := do.call(pmin, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = start_cols2]
    result[, unified_end   := do.call(pmax, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = end_cols2]
    result[, .res_id := .I]

    res_valid <- result[!is.na(unified_start) & !is.na(unified_end)]
    res_na    <- result[is.na(unified_start)  | is.na(unified_end)]

    if (nrow(res_valid) > 0) {
      setkeyv(res_valid, c("Chr", "unified_start", "unified_end"))
      setkeyv(ibd_chr,  c("Chr", "IBD_start",     "IBD_end"))

      ov_ibd <- foverlaps(res_valid, ibd_chr, type = "any", nomatch = NULL)
      ov_ibd <- ov_ibd[unified_start < IBD_end & IBD_start < unified_end]
      for (col in c("TD_Region", "iHS_Region")) {
        if (!col %in% names(ov_ibd)) ov_ibd[, (col) := NA_character_]
      }
      ov_ibd <- ov_ibd[
        (!is.na(TD_Region)  & TD_Region  == IBD_Region) |
        (!is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region == IBD_Region)
      ]

      res_matched <- ov_ibd[!is.na(.res_id), unique(.res_id)]
      ibd_matched <- ov_ibd[!is.na(.ibd_id), unique(.ibd_id)]

      if (nrow(ov_ibd) > 0) {
        ov_ibd[, .match_pop := fcoalesce(TD_Region, iHS_Region)]
        first_nonNA <- function(x) { nna <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(nna)) nna[1] else x[NA_integer_] }
        ov_ibd <- ov_ibd[, lapply(.SD, first_nonNA), by = .(.ibd_id, .match_pop)]
        ov_ibd[, .match_pop := NULL]
      }

      res_unmatched <- res_valid[!.res_id %in% res_matched]
      result <- rbind(ov_ibd, res_unmatched, res_na, fill = TRUE)

      ibd_only <- ibd_chr[!.ibd_id %in% ibd_matched]
      if (nrow(ibd_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, ibd_only, fill = TRUE)
    } else {
      result <- rbind(result, ibd_chr, fill = TRUE)
    }
    result[, c("unified_start", "unified_end", ".res_id") := NULL]
  } else if (nrow(ibd_chr) > 0) {
    result <- rbind(result, ibd_chr, fill = TRUE)
  }

  cat("    After +IBD:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  # === STEP 3: + XP-EHH ===
  if (nrow(result) > 0 && nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    start_cols <- intersect(c("TD_start", "iHS_start", "IBD_start"), names(result))
    end_cols   <- intersect(c("TD_end",   "iHS_end",   "IBD_end"),   names(result))

    result[, unified_start := do.call(pmin, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = start_cols]
    result[, unified_end   := do.call(pmax, c(.SD, list(na.rm = TRUE))), .SDcols = end_cols]
    result[, .res_id := .I]

    res_valid <- result[!is.na(unified_start) & !is.na(unified_end)]
    res_na    <- result[is.na(unified_start)  | is.na(unified_end)]

    if (nrow(res_valid) > 0) {
      setkeyv(res_valid, c("Chr", "unified_start", "unified_end"))
      setkeyv(xp_chr,   c("Chr", "XPEHH_start",   "XPEHH_end"))

      ov_xp <- foverlaps(res_valid, xp_chr, type = "any", nomatch = NULL)
      ov_xp <- ov_xp[unified_start < XPEHH_end & XPEHH_start < unified_end]

      for (col in c("TD_Region", "iHS_Region", "IBD_Region")) {
        if (!col %in% names(ov_xp)) ov_xp[, (col) := NA_character_]
      }

      ov_xp <- ov_xp[
        (!is.na(TD_Region)  & TD_Region  == XPEHH_pop1) |
          (!is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region == XPEHH_pop1) |
          (!is.na(IBD_Region) & IBD_Region == XPEHH_pop1)
      ]

      res_matched <- ov_xp[!is.na(.res_id), unique(.res_id)]
      xp_matched  <- ov_xp[!is.na(.xp_id),  unique(.xp_id)]

      if (nrow(ov_xp) > 0) {
        ov_xp[, .match_pop := fcoalesce(TD_Region, iHS_Region, IBD_Region)]
        first_nonNA <- function(x) { nna <- x[!is.na(x)]; if (length(nna)) nna[1] else x[NA_integer_] }
        ov_xp <- ov_xp[, lapply(.SD, first_nonNA), by = .(.xp_id, .match_pop)]
        ov_xp[, .match_pop := NULL]
      }

      res_unmatched <- res_valid[!.res_id %in% res_matched]
      result <- rbind(ov_xp, res_unmatched, res_na, fill = TRUE)

      xp_only <- xp_chr[!.xp_id %in% xp_matched]
      if (nrow(xp_only) > 0) result <- rbind(result, xp_only, fill = TRUE)
    } else {
      result <- rbind(result, xp_chr, fill = TRUE)
    }
    result[, c("unified_start", "unified_end", ".res_id") := NULL]
  } else if (nrow(xp_chr) > 0) {
    result <- rbind(result, xp_chr, fill = TRUE)
  }

  cat("    After +XP-EHH:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  temp_cols <- grep("^\\.|^i\\.", names(result), value = TRUE)
  if (length(temp_cols) > 0) result[, (temp_cols) := NULL]

  result <- unique(result)
  cat("    After dedup:", nrow(result), "rows\n")

  results_list[[as.character(chr)]] <- result

  rm(TD_chr, ihs_chr, ibd_chr, xp_chr, result)
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 7: COMBINE AND FINALIZE
# ==============================================================================

cat("\nCombining all chromosomes...\n")
result <- rbindlist(results_list, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
result <- unique(result)
cat("  Rows after global dedup:", nrow(result), "\n")

result[, `:=`(
  combined_start = pmin(TD_start, iHS_start, IBD_start, XPEHH_start, na.rm = TRUE),
  combined_end   = pmax(TD_end,   iHS_end,   IBD_end,   XPEHH_end,   na.rm = TRUE)
)]

setorder(result, Chr, combined_start, na.last = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# PART 8: SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("INTEGRATION COMPLETE\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Final dataset: 'result'\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(result), "\n")
cat("  Chromosomes:", paste(sort(unique(result$Chr)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

result[, n_datasets := (!is.na(TD_Region)) + (!is.na(iHS_Region)) +
         (!is.na(IBD_Region)) + (!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison))]

cat("Dataset overlap distribution:\n")
print(table(result$n_datasets))
cat("\n")

result[, combo := paste(
  ifelse(!is.na(TD_Region),        "TD",  ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(iHS_Region),       "iHS", ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(IBD_Region),       "IBD", ""),
  ifelse(!is.na(XPEHH_Comparison), "XP",  ""),
  sep = "+"
)]
result[, combo := gsub("\\+{2,}", "+", combo)]
result[, combo := gsub("^\\+|\\+$", "", combo)]

cat("Dataset combinations (top 10):\n")
print(head(sort(table(result$combo), decreasing = TRUE), 10))

cat("\nFirst 20 rows:\n")
print(head(result, 20))

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Result stored in 'result' data.table\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")

result[!is.na(TD_Region), .(N = .N,
                             min_TD  = min(TD,  na.rm = TRUE),
                             max_TD  = max(TD,  na.rm = TRUE),
                             mean_TD = mean(TD, na.rm = TRUE)),
       by = TD_Region][order(TD_Region)]

# ==============================================================================
# ANNOTATION CHECK
# ==============================================================================

gene_cols <- grep("_genes$", names(result), value = TRUE)
gene_strings <- unlist(result[, ..gene_cols])
gene_strings <- gene_strings[!is.na(gene_strings) & gene_strings != ""]

px1_hits <- grep("PF3D7_0720700", gene_strings, value = TRUE)
if (length(px1_hits) > 0) {
  for (col in gene_cols) {
    result[grepl("PF3D7_0720700", get(col)),
           (col) := gsub("PF3D7_0720700\\([^)]*\\)", "PF3D7_0720700(PX1)", get(col))]
  }
  cat("CHECK PASSED: PF3D7_0720700 found and relabelled as PX1 in", length(px1_hits), "instance(s)\n")
} else {
  # Manually annotate windows overlapping PX1 gene (Pf3D7_07_v3:889883..899213)
  px1_chr <- 7
  px1_start <- 889883
  px1_end   <- 899213
  px1_gene  <- "PF3D7_0720700(PX1)"
  px1_prod  <- "phosphoinositide-binding protein"

  px1_rows <- result[Chr == px1_chr & combined_start < px1_end & combined_end > px1_start]

  if (nrow(px1_rows) > 0) {
    prod_cols <- grep("_products$", names(result), value = TRUE)
    idx <- result[, which(Chr == px1_chr & combined_start < px1_end & combined_end > px1_start)]

    for (i in seq_along(gene_cols)) {
      gcol <- gene_cols[i]
      pcol <- prod_cols[i]
      for (r in idx) {
        cur_gene <- result[[gcol]][r]
        if (is.na(cur_gene) || cur_gene == "") {
          set(result, r, gcol, px1_gene)
          set(result, r, pcol, px1_prod)
        } else if (!grepl("PF3D7_0720700", cur_gene)) {
          set(result, r, gcol, paste0(cur_gene, ",", px1_gene))
          set(result, r, pcol, paste0(result[[pcol]][r], ",", px1_prod))
        }
      }
    }
    cat("CHECK PASSED: PX1 manually annotated in", length(idx), "overlapping window(s)\n")
  } else {
    cat("CHECK NOTE: No windows on chr 7 overlap PX1 coordinates (889883-899213)\n")
  }
}

setwd(BASE_DIR)
fwrite(result, OUT_FILE, sep = "\t")
cat("Saved:", OUT_FILE, "\n")
```

for plotting the karyogram_selection
```{r}
################################################################################
# CHUNK 12: PLOT WINDOW-LEVEL SELECTION KARYOGRAMS
# Purpose:
#   Draws chromosome-level maps of integrated selection windows. One figure shows
#   all CRT groups together, and one figure is produced for each CRT group.
# Inputs:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_window/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_windows.tsv
# Outputs:
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_crt_all.pdf
#   - output/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_<group>.pdf
# Thresholds/filters:
#   - All-group plot keeps windows detected by at least 2 tools.
#   - Gene labels on the all-group plot require at least 3 supporting tools.
#   - Per-group plots keep windows detected by at least 2 tools.
#   - CEN_ZONE=40000 defines the centromere constriction zone around each
#     chromosome centromere position for plotting only.
################################################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggforce)
library(ggrepel)

BASE_DIR <- "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/crt_genomic_background"
setwd(BASE_DIR)

IN_FILE      <- "output/comp_selection_signals_window/crt_integrated_selection_analysis_windows.tsv"
CHR_SPACING  <- 1.6
CHR_W        <- 0.28
CEN_W        <- 0.06
CEN_ZONE     <- 40000
SHAPE_RADIUS <- unit(3, "mm")

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "cvmnnk_wt" = "CRT CVMNK wild-type",
  "cviet_mut"  = "CRT CVIET mutant"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. CHROMOSOME REFERENCE DATA
# ==============================================================================

chr_lengths <- data.frame(
  Chr    = 1:14,
  length = c(643292, 947102, 1067971, 1200490, 1343557, 1418242, 1445207,
             1472805, 1541735, 1687656, 2038340, 2271494, 2925236, 3291936)
) %>% mutate(x_pos = Chr * CHR_SPACING)

centromeres <- data.frame(
  Chr     = 1:14,
  cen_mid = c(
    (458021 + 462661) / 2, (446771 + 450941) / 2,
    (593691 + 597951) / 2, (648001 + 652321) / 2,
    (454541 + 458791) / 2, (477751 + 482011) / 2,
    (863741 + 868251) / 2, (299011 + 303631) / 2,
    (1241071 + 1245441) / 2, (935681 + 937821) / 2,
    (830781 + 835431) / 2, (1281511 + 1285931) / 2,
    (1167271 + 1171921) / 2, (1070851 + 1075311) / 2
  )
) %>% left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. CHROMOSOME SHAPE
# ==============================================================================

make_chr_vertices <- function(chr_x, chr_len, cen_y,
                               full_w = CHR_W, narrow_w = CEN_W,
                               cen_zone = CEN_ZONE) {
  data.frame(
    group = as.character(chr_x),
    x = c(chr_x - full_w,   chr_x + full_w,
          chr_x + full_w,   chr_x + narrow_w,
          chr_x + full_w,   chr_x + full_w,
          chr_x - full_w,   chr_x - full_w,
          chr_x - narrow_w, chr_x - full_w),
    y = c(0,                0,
          cen_y - cen_zone, cen_y,
          cen_y + cen_zone, chr_len,
          chr_len,          cen_y + cen_zone,
          cen_y,            cen_y - cen_zone)
  )
}

chr_polys <- bind_rows(
  mapply(make_chr_vertices,
         chr_x   = chr_lengths$x_pos,
         chr_len = chr_lengths$length,
         cen_y   = centromeres$cen_mid,
         SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
)

CAP_ZONE_BP <- 55000

chr_half_width_at <- function(chr_val, y_pos) {
  cen_y   <- centromeres$cen_mid[centromeres$Chr == chr_val]
  chr_len <- chr_lengths$length[chr_lengths$Chr == chr_val]
  y_bp <- c(0, CAP_ZONE_BP, cen_y - CEN_ZONE, cen_y, cen_y + CEN_ZONE,
            chr_len - CAP_ZONE_BP, chr_len)
  w_bp <- c(0, CHR_W, CHR_W, CEN_W, CHR_W, CHR_W, 0)
  pmax(0, approx(y_bp, w_bp, xout = y_pos, rule = 2)$y)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. LOAD & PARSE DATA
# ==============================================================================

raw <- read.table(IN_FILE, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
                  fill = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "")

raw_parsed <- raw %>%
  filter(Chr != "Chr") %>%
  mutate(
    Chr            = as.integer(Chr),
    combined_start = as.numeric(combined_start),
    combined_end   = as.numeric(combined_end),
    n_datasets     = as.integer(n_datasets)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chr), !is.na(combined_start), !is.na(n_datasets))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. ALL-GROUPS WINDOWS
# ==============================================================================

windows_all <- raw_parsed %>%
  filter(n_datasets >= 2) %>%
  group_by(Chr, combined_start, combined_end) %>%
  summarise(n_datasets = max(n_datasets), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

# ==============================================================================
# 5. PER-GROUP WINDOWS
# ==============================================================================

extract_group_long <- function(df) {
  ihs <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(iHS_Region) & iHS_Region != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = iHS_Region, tool = "iHS")
  ibd <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(IBD_Region) & IBD_Region != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = IBD_Region, tool = "IBD")
  td <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(TD_Region) & TD_Region != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = TD_Region, tool = "TD")
  # XPEHH_pop1 is always the selected population (positive XPEHH, focal pop)
  xp <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(XPEHH_pop1) & XPEHH_pop1 != "") %>%
    transmute(Chr, win_start = combined_start, win_end = combined_end,
              group = XPEHH_pop1, tool = "XP-EHH")
  bind_rows(ihs, ibd, td, xp) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), group != "")
}

group_long <- extract_group_long(raw_parsed)

windows_by_group <- group_long %>%
  group_by(Chr, win_start, win_end, group) %>%
  summarise(n_datasets = n_distinct(tool), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_datasets >= 2) %>%
  left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")

# ==============================================================================
# 6. GENE LABEL EXTRACTION
# ==============================================================================

parse_gene_names <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = ends_with("_genes"), values_to = "genes") %>%
    filter(!is.na(genes), genes != "", genes != "NA(NA)") %>%
    mutate(gene_name = str_extract_all(genes, "(?<=\\()[^)]+(?=\\))")) %>%
    unnest(gene_name) %>%
    filter(!gene_name %in% c("N/A", "NA", "N", "")) %>%
    mutate(gene_name = recode(gene_name, "PPPK-DHPS" = "DHPS"))
}

extract_gene_labels <- function(windows_df, raw_src,
                                 start_col, end_col, min_tools = 3) {
  sig <- windows_df %>% filter(n_datasets >= min_tools)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(data.frame())
  raw_src %>%
    inner_join(sig, by = setNames(c("Chr", start_col, end_col),
                                   c("Chr", "combined_start", "combined_end"))) %>%
    select(Chr, combined_start, combined_end,
           any_of(c("XPEHH_genes", "IBD_genes", "iHS_genes", "TD_genes"))) %>%
    parse_gene_names() %>%
    group_by(Chr, combined_start, combined_end) %>%
    summarise(label = paste(unique(gene_name), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pos_mid = (combined_start + combined_end) / 2) %>%
    group_by(Chr, pos_mid) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")
}

get_group_gene_labels <- function(grp, windows_g, raw_parsed, min_tools = 2) {
  sig <- windows_g %>% filter(group == grp, n_datasets >= min_tools)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(data.frame())
  raw_parsed %>%
    inner_join(sig, by = c("Chr",
                           "combined_start" = "win_start",
                           "combined_end"   = "win_end")) %>%
    select(Chr, combined_start, combined_end,
           any_of(c("XPEHH_genes", "IBD_genes", "iHS_genes", "TD_genes"))) %>%
    parse_gene_names() %>%
    group_by(Chr, combined_start, combined_end) %>%
    summarise(label = paste(unique(gene_name), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pos_mid = (combined_start + combined_end) / 2) %>%
    group_by(Chr, pos_mid) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
    left_join(chr_lengths %>% select(Chr, x_pos), by = "Chr")
}

gene_labels_all <- extract_gene_labels(
  windows_all, raw_parsed,
  start_col = "combined_start", end_col = "combined_end", min_tools = 3
)

# ==============================================================================
# 7. COLOR PALETTE & CENTROMERE POINTS
# ==============================================================================

tool_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#801919",
  "2" = "#3288BD",
  "3" = "#F46D43",
  "4" = "#208363"
)
tool_labels <- c("1" = "1 tool", "2" = "2 tools",
                 "3" = "3 tools", "4" = "4 tools (all)")

cen_pts <- centromeres %>% rename(x = x_pos, y = cen_mid)

# ==============================================================================
# 8. PLOT FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================

make_karyogram <- function(windows_df, start_col, end_col,
                            gene_labs, title_str, subtitle_str) {
  win_segs <- windows_df %>%
    mutate(
      win_mid = (.data[[start_col]] + .data[[end_col]]) / 2,
      half_w  = mapply(chr_half_width_at, Chr, win_mid),
      n_fac   = factor(as.character(n_datasets), levels = as.character(1:4)),
      xmin    = x_pos - half_w,
      xmax    = x_pos + half_w,
      ymin    = .data[[start_col]],
      ymax    = .data[[end_col]]
    )

  x_breaks <- chr_lengths$x_pos
  x_labels <- as.character(chr_lengths$Chr)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_shape(data = chr_polys, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
               fill = "white", color = NA, radius = SHAPE_RADIUS) +
    geom_rect(data = win_segs,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                  fill = n_fac),
              color = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_shape(data = chr_polys, aes(x = x, y = y, group = group),
               fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5,
               radius = SHAPE_RADIUS) +
    geom_point(data = cen_pts, aes(x = x, y = y),
               shape = 16, color = "black", size = 4.5)

  if (!is.null(gene_labs) && nrow(gene_labs) > 0) {
    lab_anchor <- gene_labs %>%
      mutate(x_anchor = x_pos + CHR_W, y_anchor = pos_mid)
    p <- p +
      geom_text_repel(
        data               = lab_anchor,
        aes(x = x_anchor, y = y_anchor, label = label),
        direction          = "y",
        hjust              = 0,
        color              = "black",
        size               = 2.5,
        nudge_x            = 0.08,
        segment.color      = "grey40",
        segment.size       = 0.3,
        segment.linetype   = "solid",
        min.segment.length = 0,
        box.padding        = 0.2,
        point.padding      = 0,
        max.overlaps       = Inf,
        seed               = 42
      )
  }

  p +
    scale_fill_manual(values = tool_colors, labels = tool_labels,
                      name = "Tools detecting window", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels,
                       expand = expansion(add = c(0.8, 2.2))) +
    scale_y_reverse(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x / 1e6, 1), " Mb"),
                    expand = expansion(mult = 0.03)) +
    labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Position",
         title = title_str, subtitle = subtitle_str) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      axis.line       = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40")
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 9. ALL-GROUPS FIGURE
# ==============================================================================

p_all <- make_karyogram(
  windows_all,
  start_col    = "combined_start",
  end_col      = "combined_end",
  gene_labs    = gene_labels_all,
  title_str    = "Integrated Selection Signals - CRT K76T (Ethiopia)",
  subtitle_str = "Windows detected by >=2 tools | iHS, XP-EHH, Tajima's D, IBD"
)

ggsave("output/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_crt_all.pdf", plot = p_all,
       width = 20, height = 10, device = "pdf")
message("Saved: karyogram_crt_all.pdf")

# ==============================================================================
# 10. PER-GROUP FIGURES
# ==============================================================================

groups <- sort(unique(windows_by_group$group))
message("Generating per-group figures for: ", paste(groups, collapse = ", "))

for (grp in groups) {
  win_g <- windows_by_group %>% filter(group == grp)
  glabs <- get_group_gene_labels(grp, windows_by_group, raw_parsed, min_tools = 2)

  grp_label <- ifelse(grp %in% names(GROUP_LABELS), GROUP_LABELS[[grp]], grp)

  p_g <- make_karyogram(
    win_g,
    start_col    = "win_start",
    end_col      = "win_end",
    gene_labs    = glabs,
    title_str    = paste0("Selection Signals - ", grp_label),
    subtitle_str = "Windows detected by >=2 tools | iHS, XP-EHH, Tajima's D, IBD"
  )

  fname <- paste0("output/comp_selection_signals_window/karyogram_", grp)
  ggsave(paste0(fname, ".pdf"), plot = p_g, width = 20, height = 10, device = "pdf")
  message("  Saved: ", fname)
}
```
